messages:
lakeshore-support: Hey team — Lakeshore reporting p99 spikes on text-gen API for the last ~20m. p95 looks OK (~400ms) but p99 up to 5-8s and some client timeouts. Customer says this started right after a large embeddings job. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.dev/tenant/lakeshore/overview?span=30m

sam.c: On it, pulling traces and queue metrics now. Do we know which model/routes affected?

alerts-bot: ALERT: tenant=lakeshore p99_latency > 3000ms (window=15m) — triggered at 3348001055.

jess: Looks like most hits are to /v1/generate with model=lakeshore-internal-gpt, and a burst of bulk embed requests to /v1/embeddings ~00:20 ago.

raj: Correlating infra: worker-shard-12 queue depth jumped around 3348000900, redis list length CLUSTER:rbq-12 spiked to 18k. Host g3-14-2 shows CPU steal spikes and iowait. Suspect noisy neighbor from a bulk job on the same shard. Snippet from host metrics:

```
[3348000905] redis_queue_len=18234 host=g3-14-2 cpu_steal=12.8% iowait=6.1% net_q=42
[3348000955] active_gen_requests=246 p99_token_latency_ms=4123
```

sam.c: Good catch. If the embed job saturated the shard KV cache and caused larger seq lengths, that would amplify per-token cost and queueing. Recommend: 1) temporary per-tenant throttle / reservation to protect tail, 2) move Lakeshore traffic off shard-12 (reshuffle), or 3) short-term priority allowlist to let them finish without timeouts.

lakeshore-support: Customer says they can pause the bulk embed if we ask, but they prefer not to. They asked for a quick mitigation so their live users don't see errors.

jess: I can flip a soft reservation: reduce max_concurrency for embeddings for other tenants on shard-12 and add Lakeshore to a short priority lane for 10 minutes. That buys time. Also propose lowering per-request token cap for embed jobs to smooth spikes.

raj: I'm going to push a rate-limiter change to apply a per-tenant cap on shard-12 now. Pushing canary to two hosts first. Command I used: `curl -XPOST https://ops.redwood.internal/config/rate-limiter -d '{"shard":"shard-12","tenant":"lakeshore","max_concurrency":8}'`

alerts-bot: INFO: rate-limiter change detected for shard-12 by raj at 3348002250.

sam.c: Created ticket SUP-3492 and ENG-SRE incident 2026-03-17-01. Notifying customer success and eng-oncall. Added temporary priority allowlist entry id=prio-334800 for 10m.

lydia: I informed CS to tell customer we applied a temporary priority lane and are monitoring. Also asked them to schedule the bulk embed to off-peak tomorrow.

jess: After the rate-limiter patch we see queue depth dropping on shard-12 and p99 coming down to ~900ms in the last 3m. Still monitoring, will roll the change to the rest of the hosts if stable.

raj: Follow-up infra notes: need to consider longer-term: shard isolation for heavy embed workloads, auto-eviction for long-running embed jobs, and prefix-KV cache partitioning. Logged as ENG-OPT-821.

lakeshore-support: Customer confirmed latency improved on their side and accepted the 10-minute priority lane. They'll pause any additional bulk runs for now. Thanks all :thumbsup: 

sam.c: Closing handoff to eng-sre for retention actions. Will update SUP-3492 with next steps (reservation plan + quota adjustments).

lydia: I'll do the customer follow-up and get them a runbook for embed best-practices (chunking, backoff, schedule).

jess: Monitoring for 30m. If p99 spikes again, we'll escalate to a shard reshuffle.

lakeshore-support: noted — will ping if customer sees anything else.
